verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships Loop, an in-product AI agent that investigates logs through natural language and builds scorers, datasets and dashboards. Patterns runs Loop on a schedule to surface recurring problems, with supporting traces and a suggested fix. Topics automatically clusters and classifies traces, so AI-generated insights and suggestions are clearly delivered inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Loop/Patterns output quality.
